about_the_game:
Ultra Age ‘Rebirth Project’ is a completely new rogue-lite side game with loads of content that can be accessed from the main menu after the player has reached a certain point in the main game.

While exploring a portal in the Frontier Shelter, Age is suddenly transported to what appears to be a laboratory by an unknown force. The laboratory seems to be a testing site for analyzing creatures, filled with many devices to measure and record combat capabilities and strengthen their weaknesses. The subjects undergo repeated experiments in order to reach perfection, created solely from data.

Age becomes a reincarnated construct, constantly respawned by Helvis in the laboratory, with a 'different Age' participating in an experiment each time... A combat experiment that cannot be escaped until it is fully completed. Will Age be able to escape the 'Rebirth Project'?

■ A NEW ROGUE-LITE ADVENTURE
Every run is different. Control Age’s reincarnated construct and fight through a series of hexagonal zones on each floor, comprised of battle, challenge and elite zones with increasing difficulty and rewards. New monsters and bosses not seen in the main game will appear. If you’re lucky, you’ll come across an Upgrade, Recovery or Shop zone to help continue your run. Use your accumulated crystals to permanently upgrade Age in the Lobby for a better chance at survival. The laboratory consists of 30 floors in total, with a major boss fight every 10 floors and the Final Boss on the 30th, guarding Age’s escape.

■ ENHANCED UPGRADE SYSTEM
The 'Rebirth Project' incorporates a 'Synergy' effect that gets stronger the longer Age survives. The 'Modules' used to increase capabilities in the original game have been expanded and enhanced – they now offer unique buffs to Age for each run that can be found and employed in a more simplified manner. This allows the player to combine Module and Blade characteristics to create powerful builds that weren't possible in the original game.

■ IMPROVED CONVENIENCE FOR VARIOUS WEAPONS
In the 'Rebirth Project', affinities of blades in the original game such as the Katana, which is strong against living creatures, and the Claymore, which is strong against robots, have been modified to deal more damage. Affinity buffs against enemies remain intact, while the damage reductions have been removed, making for a more comfortable experience. Feel free to switch blades more freely to continue your combos!

Rebirth Project adds a completely separate game experience to Ultra Age with tons to unlock where players can challenge themselves and hone their skills, providing hours and hours of gameplay for free.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 /8.1 /10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 2100 or AMD A8-6500
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 770 VRAM 2GB or AMD Radeon R9 270X VRAM 2GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 8.1 /10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4670 or AMD A10-7850K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 980 VRAM 4GB or AMD Radeon R9 380X VRAM 4GB
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX® 11 supported

short_description: Ultra Age ‘Rebirth Project’ is a completely new rogue-lite side game featuring 30 floors of pure hack n' slash combat, an enhanced upgrade system, improved blade affinities, new bosses and more. Players can hone their skills and challenge themselves with hours and hours of new gameplay, for free.
